content.text: Prime Video's own series are the main reason many people subscribe. These Amazon originals are made for Prime Video, so you will find them in almost every country, including Oman. Here are 12 of the best Prime Video shows, from superheroes and fantasy to comedy and romance.
1. The Boys

What if superheroes were famous, rich and completely corrupt? The Boys follows a small group of ordinary people fighting the world's most powerful heroes, led by the terrifying Homelander. It is violent, funny and very sharp, and its college spin-off Gen V is great too. For adults only.
2. Fallout

Based on the famous video games, Fallout follows Lucy, played by Ella Purnell, who leaves her safe underground vault and steps into a destroyed Los Angeles 200 years after a nuclear war. Walton Goggins steals every scene as the Ghoul. You do not need to know the games to love it.
3. The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power

Set thousands of years before The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings, The Rings of Power shows how the rings were made and how Sauron rose. It is one of the most expensive series ever made, and every episode looks like a film. Start here if you love Middle-earth.
4. Invincible

Mark is the teenage son of the world's strongest superhero, and when his own powers arrive, he learns a shocking secret about his father. Invincible is animated, with Steven Yeun and J. K. Simmons as voices, but it is not for kids: it is one of the most surprising superhero stories on any service.

content.text: 5. The Wheel of Time

Rosamund Pike plays Moiraine, a powerful magic user who takes five young people from a small village on a dangerous journey, believing one of them is the Dragon Reborn who will save or destroy the world. Based on Robert Jordan's huge fantasy books, it ran for three seasons. A good pick to download for a long flight.
6. Carnival Row

Orlando Bloom plays a detective and Cara Delevingne a faerie refugee in a Victorian-style city where humans and mythical creatures live side by side and do not get along. Carnival Row mixes murder mystery, fantasy and romance over two seasons, and its full story is complete, so you can binge it from start to end.
7. Good Omens

An angel (Michael Sheen) and a demon (David Tennant) who have lived on Earth for 6,000 years and like it too much team up to stop the end of the world. Funny, clever and kind, based on the book by Neil Gaiman and Terry Pratchett.
8. Upload

In the near future, people who die can be uploaded into a luxury digital afterlife. Nathan, played by Robbie Amell, wakes up in one after a car crash and falls for the customer service worker looking after him. A light science-fiction comedy that ran for four seasons.
9. The Summer I Turned Pretty
Belly spends every summer at a beach house with two brothers she has known all her life, and one summer everything changes. A hugely popular teen romance based on Jenny Han's books.
10. The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel
In 1950s New York, a perfect housewife finds out she has a talent for stand-up comedy. Five seasons of sharp jokes, beautiful costumes and many awards.
11. The Peripheral

Chloë Grace Moretz plays a young woman in a small town who tests what she thinks is a new virtual-reality game and finds it is a real future London. A smart science-fiction thriller based on William Gibson's novel.
12. Hazbin Hotel
The princess of Hell opens a hotel to help demons become better so they can go to Heaven. An animated adult musical comedy with catchy songs and a big fan base.
